# Typography & Font Requirements Checklist: Multilingual Support (English & Farsi)

**Purpose**: Validate that the feature's requirements adequately specify Farsi typography/font sourcing, placement, fallback, and non-functional behavior — before font files are added and wired in
**Created**: 2026-09-03
**Feature**: [spec.md](../spec.md), [plan.md](../plan.md), [contracts/page-variant-contract.md](../contracts/page-variant-contract.md)

**Note**: This custom checklist is generated by the `/speckit-checklist` command based on feature context and requirements.
**Review Ownership**: This checklist is a reviewer-owned requirements-quality review artifact. Mark an item `[x]` only when the reviewer determines the requirements-quality criterion is satisfied.
**Marker Semantics**: `[x]` means the criterion has been reviewed and satisfied for requirements quality. It does not mean implementation work is complete.

## Font Selection & Sourcing

- [ ] CHK001 Is the required Farsi typeface (IranSans) and its exact edition/version specified anywhere in the feature's requirements? [Gap]
- [ ] CHK002 Is the licensing/redistribution status of the IranSans font files documented and validated before committing them to the repository? [Assumption, Gap]
- [ ] CHK003 Are the specific font weights/styles required (e.g., regular, bold, medium) enumerated, rather than left to whatever files happen to be supplied? [Clarity, Gap]
- [ ] CHK004 Are the required font file formats (e.g., woff2, woff, ttf) specified, with a rationale for which are "necessary" versus removable? [Clarity, Gap]

## Folder Structure & Placement

- [ ] CHK005 Is the target folder path for font assets defined as part of the project structure (e.g., in plan.md's Structure Decision), or left ambiguous? [Gap, Spec plan.md §Project Structure]
- [ ] CHK006 Does the page-variant contract specify how a Farsi page variant references or loads font assets? [Gap, Consistency, Spec contracts/page-variant-contract.md]
- [ ] CHK007 Is there a documented criterion for deciding which files in a delivered font package are "necessary" versus "the rest" to be removed? [Ambiguity]

## Typography Requirements — Clarity & Consistency

- [ ] CHK008 Does the spec define which font family applies to Farsi-language pages versus the existing English font stack, rather than leaving both to inherit the same declaration by default? [Clarity, Gap]
- [ ] CHK009 Is the fallback font chain specified for Farsi text when IranSans fails to load (e.g., missing file, unsupported format)? [Edge Case, Gap]
- [ ] CHK010 Are font requirements defined for inline Latin/technical terms within Farsi text (e.g., acronyms and proper nouns per FR-006) so they stay legible once the surrounding font changes to IranSans? [Consistency, Spec §FR-006]
- [ ] CHK011 Is it specified whether English-language pages must keep their current font stack unchanged, so introducing IranSans does not unintentionally affect Latin-script pages? [Consistency, Gap]

## Non-Functional Requirements

- [ ] CHK012 Are font-loading performance requirements (e.g., added page weight, font-display strategy) defined and reconciled with the feature's "under 1 second" language-switch success criterion? [Non-Functional, Spec §SC-001]
- [ ] CHK013 Are font-loading requirements for offline/local-file usage defined, consistent with the constitution's self-contained, no-build-step principle? [Non-Functional, Consistency]
- [ ] CHK014 Is a maximum file count/size for retained font assets specified, to bound what gets committed to the repository? [Non-Functional, Gap]

## Scenario & Edge Case Coverage

- [ ] CHK015 Are requirements defined for whether Days 2–10 (currently untranslated) require the Farsi font once translated, or only the two pages in this feature's initial scope? [Coverage, Gap]
- [ ] CHK016 Is there a requirement covering what a page should do if the user-supplied fonts folder is missing a weight/format a page references? [Edge Case, Gap]
- [ ] CHK017 Are verification requirements defined for confirming Farsi glyphs render with IranSans rather than a silently-substituted fallback? [Coverage, Measurability, Gap]

## Dependencies & Assumptions

- [ ] CHK018 Is the dependency on a user-provided, externally-sourced fonts folder (rather than a project-managed asset pipeline) recorded as an assumption in spec.md's Assumptions section? [Assumption, Gap]
- [ ] CHK019 Is it documented whether the same font files serve all current and future Farsi pages, or whether each page family supplies its own? [Assumption, Consistency]

## Ambiguities & Conflicts

- [ ] CHK020 Does "put necessary files in the proper folder and then remove the rest" define who or what determines necessity (e.g., only weights/formats actually referenced by CSS), or is this left to implementer judgment? [Ambiguity]

## Notes

- Mark items `[x]` only after review confirms the requirement-quality criterion is satisfied
- Leave items unchecked when they still require clarification, correction, or reviewer evaluation
- `/speckit-implement` reads checklist checkbox state as a gate and must not modify markers
- `checklists/requirements.md` has a separate built-in lifecycle maintained by `/speckit-specify` and `/speckit-clarify`
- The actual font file placement/cleanup requested alongside this checklist is implementation work, out of scope for `/speckit-checklist` — see the accompanying response for next steps
